brief: A GitHub-Desktop-class Git client rebuilt in Rust on gpui: frosted glass, lime accent, quick and a little playful. The logo has to live next to Safari, Xcode and Terminal in the Dock, at 16 px in a README badge, and in the app's own titlebar.
criteria: Success: reads at 16 px, holds in one colour, unmistakably not a branch-with-nodes Git icon, and gives the empty states and mascot a character to grow from.

concepts.name: Commit Buddy
concepts.idea: The mascot is the commit: a cheerful blob sitting on the history line.
rationale: The face is the product's tone of voice — warm where every other Git client is technical
The line through it is history, so the mark still says what the app does
One shape at every size: Dock icon, 16 px favicon, in-app mascot, empty states

next_steps: Swap the placeholder in-app mascot for this drawing (components/mascot.rs)
Check trademark availability for the name and mark
Draw a second pose (celebrate / ponder) so the logo can animate
recommendation: One direction, built to grow: the same drawing is the Dock icon, the favicon and the in-app mascot.
